stem: Which sentence from the selection best shows that Dahl was a daring person?

options.label: F
options.text: While Dahl may be best known as an author of famous children’s books, he also had an interesting life unrelated to his writing.

options.label: G
options.text: Before he started writing, he traveled to other countries, flew fighter planes, and worked as a spy.

options.label: H
options.text: Dahl soon learned that Africa had many new things to see.

options.label: J
options.text: The mystery stories were quite popular.
